items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I'd say that too. But see Earl got better.

ctx.x: Well his wife was a piano player and she was in Chicago and she said that when Earl came to Chicago they played together, you know they used to run around together and played together. But she said that in her opinion Teddy Wetherford was never their equal.
Yes, I'd say that too. But see Earl got better.
